rows.Col10: Update Notes:

Granville sustained a season-ending injury during practice leading into the Week 2 matchup against Temple. The edge rusher will miss the remainder of the 2026 campaign while shifting his focus to long-term rehabilitation.

Robinson suffered a season-ending injury near the start of spring practice, extending a difficult stretch of physical setbacks. The defensive end remains sidelined on the out-for-season list with all focus turned toward full recovery for 2027.

Tompkins sustained a severe injury in late September that abruptly brought an end to his 2026 campaign. Coaching staff confirmed the offensive lineman will miss the rest of the year while undergoing rehabilitation.

Howard was officially ruled out on the November 6 Big Ten availability report ahead of the November 7 road trip to Washington. The wide receiver did not dress for competition and remains day-to-day moving into the next preparation cycle.

Armstead was added to the availability report as out ahead of Week 4 and has not been cleared to return to live action. The defensive back remains sidelined outside the primary secondary rotation pending medical clearance.

Alexander has been sidelined since preseason camp after sustaining an undisclosed injury that kept him out of the opener. The tight end continues to carry an out designation with no definitive timetable set for his return.

Askew missed the late-September clash against Wisconsin before being downgraded to out on subsequent availability reports. The cornerback remains out of game action as he continues to work through recovery protocols.

Tatsch carried a questionable designation into mid-October preparations before being officially ruled out for Week 6 action. The linebacker remains unavailable for defensive rotation work while continuing through team evaluation.

Andrews landed on the mid-October availability report as out ahead of conference action and did not suit up. The interior defensive lineman remains sidelined pending further clearance from medical personnel.

Davis was officially ruled out on the October 28 availability update leading into the October 31 game against Purdue. The safety did not dress for live action and remains day-to-day on the defensive depth chart.

Carnell was downgraded from questionable to out on the October 30 report ahead of the October 31 matchup. The defensive tackle was held out of contest action and continues to be evaluated week-to-week.
